Title: A live Firebase admin service-account private key file sits in the project folder (OneDrive-synced)
Evidence: File italianshoes-firebase-adminsdk-fbsvc-d8d1b2abaf.json (type=service_account, project italianshoes, private_key present). It is git-ignored (.gitignore:8) and git log shows it was never committed. docs/GO-LIVE.md step 3 says it must be rotated and the copy deleted; no evidence that happened
Recommended fix: Revoke this key in Google Cloud IAM and create a new one only inside Vercel env vars; delete the local file; keep it out of OneDrive
Verification test required: Old key id no longer listed in IAM; app still works with the new Vercel key

Title: Production dependency vulnerabilities (4 high, 6 moderate); CI audit step would fail
Evidence: npm audit --omit=dev: zod 4.6.7 'can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections' (high; zod validates every endpoint); @vercel/blob -> @vercel/oidc -> @vercel/cli-config (high); minimatch/glob/rimraf/gaxios/google-gax (moderate); functions: 6 moderate. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs 'npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev'
Recommended fix: Upgrade zod and @vercel/blob to the fixed versions npm suggests, re-run tests; keep Dependabot on
Verification test required: npm audit --omit=dev shows no high/critical; full test suite green

Title: Revoked or disabled staff keep access for up to an hour on 25 endpoints that have no static permission
Evidence: functions/lib/callable.js:73-79 calls assertSessionStillValid only when options.permission is set. Endpoints with auth 'required' and no static permission (registry listing): analyticsReport, analyticsExport, listReportConfigs, reportInbox, reportRun, hrReport, getHrSettings, getPayslip, hrMyProfile, myAttendance, myLeave, myAdvances, myPayslips, applyLeave, cancelLeave, leaveBalance, listHolidays, requestAdvance, cancelAdvance (plus customer endpoints placeOrder, cancelMyOrder, submitReview, quoteCheckout, claimOwner)
Recommended fix: Run assertSessionStillValid for every authenticated staff call (or when token.staff is true) in runEndpoint
Verification test required: Emulator test: disable a staff user, then call analyticsReport/hrReport/getPayslip with the still-valid token and expect an error

Title: Employee CNIC scans and expense receipts are stored as PUBLIC blobs
Evidence: src/admin/hrUi.js uploadHrFile and src/admin/financeUi.js uploadReceipt call upload(..., { access: 'public' }); anyone holding a document URL can open it; removing the record in Firestore does not delete the file (functions/services/hr.js removeDocument only deletes the Firestore row); Vercel Blob URL contains a random suffix but is not access controlled
Recommended fix: Store sensitive documents behind an authenticated download (server fetches the blob with the token) or private storage; delete the blob when the record is removed; do not store CNIC images until fixed
Verification test required: Unauthenticated GET of a stored document URL must fail

Title: Setting 'Customers can create accounts' (registrationOpen) is saved but never enforced
Evidence: grep registrationOpen: only shared/schemas/commerce.js:101 and src/admin/views/settings.js:77; no rule, endpoint or sign-up code reads it
Recommended fix: Enforce in sign-up (Auth blocking function is not on the free plan: enforce in rules for users/{uid} create or in the first server call) or remove the toggle
Verification test required: With the toggle off a new customer cannot create a profile

Title: Owner sign-in claim exceeded Firebase's 1000-character limit once HR permissions were added
Evidence: Measured: full Owner permission list = 1,219 characters (999 before HR). Fixed in the working copy with a wildcard claim (shared/permissions.js claimPerms/expandClaimPerms, functions/lib/callable.js, src/app/session.js, firestore.rules can()), but this is uncommitted; deploying only some of these files would lock the Owner out
Recommended fix: Deploy the claim change, rules and server together; re-save the Owner roles so the claim is rewritten as '*'
Verification test required: Sign in as Owner on the deployed site and open an HR and an Analytics page
